name: haze
description: Houdiniと立体造形勉強中のコンセプトアーティストです🎨イラスト描いたり3D作ったりプログラム書いたりします🦕画像無断利用・転載・トレス・AI学習は×

works.body:
Hello haze-san!

May I request an artwork of my character Aurora?
I'm leaving the pose and composition up to you.
Feel free to draw her based on your interpretation!

Thank you so much for your consideration.

https://www.dropbox.com/s/scvmn3lcn9bflor/ref_resize.png?dl=0

Nice to meet you!
I've seen some great illustrations on social media and elsewhere! (I personally like the vibe of creation 34 and 39 terribly.)

If you can, could you please do an OC illustration of FF14?

 [Character references]
https://imgur.com/a/E3uweRy ...

  [Contents]
●Please dress in materials.
Please be a little dark and sexy, like exploring old books.
For the rest, we'll leave the details up to you.

 Please consider, please.

Hello! I'd like to get a piece with my character "Momo"! She is a cheerful magical girl with a peach motif. Pose and facial expression is up to you!
Thank you very much!!

https://imgur.com/a/yQAylPw

Hello. Could I request an illustration of my character?

Reference: https://sta.sh/2166yvpw6u5s
(Mechanical limbs are optional)

He has the appearance of a young boy, with a serene and pleasant expression. He is a doll maker - I would like for the picture to have a somewhat dark mood, maybe with marionette or mannequin pieces.

Thank you for your consideration.

Nice to meet you, I'm fascinated by all the wonderful illustrations on Twitter media.
I'm requesting to draw my own character from FFXIV, if you don't mind.
Her race is Aura vagina, her hair color is blonde, her hairstyle is the same as Lightning's from FFXIII, and her equipment is the steampunk one from the materials.
You may or may not have a hat and a gun.

She's sitting at a desk or a chair, in a sissy sort of way.
Image wise, this is what it looks like (I want your expression to be crisp)
https://www.pixiv.net/artworks/77334915
Or, haze, make the composition and pose look good on my boy!

The file format is psd (if you can't deliver it, you can cancel it)
It would be helpful if the address could be turned on/off in psd.

I apologize for this detailed request, but I appreciate your consideration.

https://imgur.com/a/WdWqzYS

Hello!
Can you please draw my character ?
https://toyhou.se/5796760.maud#19161927
She is a lively young girl. She loves travelling and eating sweets.
I would also appreciate if you could draw her another cute or cool outfit and hairstyle. If not, please draw her wearing this : https://toyhou.se/5796760.maud/7524656.new-outfit
Pose and expression are up to you.
Thank you very much!
